message.content: The stock closed at 333.42 within an uptrend where the session high reached 333.82 and the session low was 325.75, trading above both the 50-day average of 325.75 and the 20-day average of 328.90 while remaining well above the 200-day average of 290.92. Technical indicators suggest volatility with a 14-day average true range of 10.64 and relative strength index at 54.21, positioning the price near immediate resistance at 366.41 but supported by a level at 332.78. The company demonstrated strong earnings performance with the latest quarter showing an actual result of 2.82 against an estimate of 2.16, resulting in a surprise of 30.56 per cent and a subsequent move of -6.32 per cent on the report date of 2026-08-19.
